veranderings.blok: Hoe brande in ons gemeenskappe begin
veranderings.voor: kry vuurhoutjies of 'n aansteker in die hande
veranderings.na: kry vuurhoutjies of 'n aansteker in hul hande
veranderings.rede: 'In hul hande kry' is the natural possessive form; 'in die hande' reads like an anglicised or clipped construction.

veranderings.blok: Hoe brande in ons gemeenskappe begin
veranderings.rede: A Grade 5 reader can take 'kom ... uit' as 'heat comes out of fuel', the opposite of the intended 'heat reaches fuel'; 'bereik' removes that misreading.

veranderings.na: hoog op 'n plek waar klein kinders
veranderings.rede: 'Hoog op waar' leaves 'op' hanging without a noun; naming 'n plek makes the relative clause attach cleanly.
'Lig gee' is the idiomatic Afrikaans collocation for a lamp; 'lig maak' is wooden.
